# Your Daily Briefing – Sunday 8 November

Yesterday was a quieter day — no training session logged and 6,565 steps, which is a decent baseline of movement. Your body burned 2,451 kcal, so staying close to your 2,300 kcal target keeps things on track for that 80-85kg goal. The main flag though is sleep: 4.8 hours simply isn't enough recovery time, full stop.

That sleep shortfall is showing up in your HRV sitting at 89ms, just below your 91-123ms baseline. It's not a crisis, but your body is telling you it's slightly under-recovered. If you have a session planned today, keep it easy — think Zone 2 or a relaxed walk rather than anything intense.

Tonight, prioritise sleep above everything else. Aim for 8 hours — it'll do more for your fitness than any workout right now. Hit your 175g protein today to protect muscle while you're in a calorie deficit.
